verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.translation: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.translation: and those that are heavily laden,

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.translation: that speed freely,

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.translation: that distribute [rain] as ordained!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.translation: What you [people] are promised is true:

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.translation: the Judgement will come––

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.translation: by the sky with its pathways,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.translation: you differ in what you say––

verses.text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.translation: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.

verses.text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.translation: Perish the liars,

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.translation: those steeped in error and unaware!

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translation: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.translation: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,

verses.text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.translation: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translation: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translation: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:

verses.text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.translation: sleeping only little at night,

verses.text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.translation: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.translation: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.translation: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translation: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.translation: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.translation: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.translation: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.translation: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translation: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.translation: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.translation: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translation: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translation: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.translation: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,

verses.text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.translation: to bring down rocks of clay,

verses.text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translation: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: We brought out such believers as were there-

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.translation: We found only one household devoted to God-

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.translation: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translation: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.translation: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.translation: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them

verses.text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.translation: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.

verses.text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.translation: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translation: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.translation: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.translation: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.translation: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.translation: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translation: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.

verses.text_uthmani: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translation: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.translation: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.translation: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.translation: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.translation: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.translation: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.translation: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.translation: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translation: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
